Regenerate the synthetic files with `node tests/fixtures/build.mjs`.

Generated at test time, never committed (`makeRuntimeFixtures()` / `makeBigFixture()` in `build.mjs`):

- `encrypted_userpw_1234.pdf`: pages of `kr_law_form.pdf` encrypted with @cantoo/pdf-lib `encrypt` (user password `1234`, AES-256).
- `damaged_badxref.pdf`: `kr_law_form.pdf` with `startxref` set to 999.
- `truncated.pdf`: the first 60 % of `irs_fw9.pdf`.
- `not_a_pdf.pdf`: 1×1 PNG bytes saved with a `.pdf` name.
- `big_51mb.pdf` (e2e only): 1-page PDF padded with an unreferenced 51 MB stream, for the merge mobile soft limit.
- `big_21mb.pdf` (e2e only): the same with 21 MB, for the PDF 용량 줄이기 mobile soft limit (20 MB).
- `owner_restricted.pdf`: the pages of `kr_law_form.pdf` encrypted by qpdf-wasm (`--encrypt '' owner 256`): opens without a password, edit-restricted.
- `signed_fake.pdf`: `kr_law_form.pdf` plus an AcroForm `/FT /Sig` field whose `/V` has `/ByteRange` and `/Contents` (not a real signature).
- `jpx_only.pdf`: one page drawing a 200×200 `/JPXDecode` image of 64 KB seeded bytes.
- `cmyk_jpeg.pdf`: one page drawing a 900×900 JPEG with a `/DeviceCMYK` dictionary (the JPEG bytes are RGB; the skip rule reads the dictionary only).
- `junk_content.pdf`: one 900×900 JPEG whose only `Do` is swallowed by garbage content (unbalanced `q`, stray delimiters, a 1 MB token, an unterminated string).
